items.title: Owners and administrators
items.content: Use co-owner for durable administration and admin for delegated operations. The owner remains unique.

items.title: Members
items.content: Members receive only scope and application access explicitly granted to them.

items.title: Children and guests
items.content: Child and guest access should be bounded by scope, expiry, or application role.

fields.title: Registered credentials
fields.content: Only device credentials registered with Users & Access are shown here. Browser endpoints and subnet members are managed on their own system surfaces.

fields.title: What revocation does
fields.content: Revoke immediately disables this session credential. It does not remove the user or their other sessions.

fields.title: Permission-centric application access
fields.content: Select a permission to see every immutable Application release that declares it. Effective access is summarized from subject grants; declarations cannot be changed from this inventory.
